decision.text: Streams started under a page PAUSE on Router deactivate and RESUME from offset on return, instead of drop(). Alternative: drop and rely on the page calling live() again. Rejected: probe showed /framework/ai/ is cached, its page.jsonl and index.jsonl streams started once at load and never restarted on return.

log.msg: Built: core/Page/Page.class.js sets globalThis.$page in activate() and emits left/entered on itself (Page.bubbles() is false); ext/JSONL/live.js adopt() pauses/resumes. No ext import in core. Headless proof on the worktree server: /framework/ai/ -> core -> JSONL -> back: unsubscribe frames sent on leave (11 -> 8 page streams released), re-subscribed on return, a line appended while away did not arrive, one appended after return did. Probe: ext/JSONL/doc/probe-unsubscribe.mjs. Left open: streams started with no page active (8 embedded ai/tests previews, dev/mobile, dev bar) are never paused; a live() called after an await attributes to whichever page is current then. Docs updated: ext/JSONL/readme.md, doc/live.md. Not merged: parent reviews.

finish.summary: Page streams pause on leave, resume on return; commits 1359b25e0, de7d9b089 on worktree/jsonl-unsubscribe.
